description: This Java class 'HttpRequestHandler' handles HTTP requests within a Netty server environment, managing various request types such as status checks, port binding, server stopping, dashboard access, metrics, and proxy CONNECT requests. It integrates with mock server configurations, logging, metrics, and SSL handling.
